description: c118 connectivity-pillar coverage: proves the client boots with the network stack alive (netInit + p2pInit + presenceInit all run) without the firewall focus-steal class crashing the harness or producing connectivity-error log channels. All five existing smoke tests (boot_smoke, mod_load_smoke, mp_room_flow, mission_intro_flow, full_sdl_pipeline_smoke) drop --no-net + skip netInit/p2pInit; this test deliberately omits --no-net so the ENet stack initialises (enet_initialize -> stunInit -> arg-latch parsing), p2pLanStart binds UDP 27101 for LAN-broadcast advertising, and presenceInit binds UDP 27105 for the Ed25519 v2 presence signal. The firewall allow rule pinned by Install-Harness.ps1 is path-pinned to <install>/PerfectDark.exe -- the same exe path boot_smoke + mod_load_smoke already use -- so no firewall prompt fires on this run (closes the dispatch's main risk class). netStartServer is NOT auto-called from any CLI flag (--host only sets g_NetHostLatch -- the actual host bind requires menu interaction), so this test asserts on the connectivity-stack INIT contract instead: ENet init success (absence of 'NET: could not init ENet'), P2P LAN tier socket bound, PRESENCE socket bound + initialised state. Sister test for the connectivity pillar; first smoke fixture in the suite to exercise the post-netInit code path.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --skip-intro re-routes g_StageNum from STAGE_TITLE to STAGE_CITRAINING so we don't sit in the bouncy attract loop, but the connectivity-stack init we're asserting on (netInit, p2pInit, presenceInit) all fire BEFORE mainProc enters its loop. Per the recorded mod_load_smoke run, PRESENCE: socket bound and P2P.LAN: listener bound both land within the first 100ms of boot. No --no-net here -- the whole point is to prove the firewall path-pinned allow rule lets the network stack come up cleanly on the same canonical PerfectDark.exe used by every other smoke test.

scripted exit at 12s -- connectivity init is complete by ~3s on a clean install; 9s headroom covers cold-start variance + asset catalog warm-up + lvTick first-render. modmgr: shutdown fires on exit which produces the SMOKE: result=scripted_exit sentinel.

forbidden_patterns: NET: could not init ENet, disabling networking
NET: could not create ENet host on port \d+
